changes: Only the crash-test fixture uses a diagnostic wrapper around the unchanged production enrollment exchange.
Its artifact records allowlisted exception kinds, numeric OS error codes and elapsed times; no request, credential, URL, body or exception text.

Changed reviews and semantic/refusal errors fail immediately. Pairing creation is never retried. Recovery categories are retained in the fixture artifact.
No skipped crash cases, relaxed crash assertions or production deadline changes.
